name: finddata-coding-crew
description: A seven-role coding crew with typed contracts: relay measures the model path and hands out the concurrency width, planner slices the work, explorer and implementer run in parallel after the contractor pins the public interface to one machine-readable contract, sentry gates the merge on artifacts that actually exist, merger carries every branch constraint forward, verifier gates the result. Ships the agent-graph-gate skill that checks the collaboration graph's shape before dispatch.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 七角色协作编码班底，带类型化契约：探路者先量模型路径并给出本轮并发宽度、契约官把公开接口钉成一份机器可读契约、规划者切片、侦察与实现并行、守门者在合并前验产物真在、合并者承接各分支约束、验收者把关；附带派发前检查协作图形状的 agent-graph-gate 技能。
